label: IDU person ID
missing: Nothing could be captured: the page is a CAPTCHA ('Robots are not life... Rewrite characters in the window: Check'), and the screenshot is blank.
label_issues: status 'wrong_page' with reason 'page rendered but never mentions the entity' is misleading. This is a bot challenge (CAPTCHA), so status should be challenge_suspected (or blocked), not a wrong page. The current label suggests the Wikidata id may be wrong, but nothing indicates that.
notable: Whether 4559 is his record cannot be judged from this crawl.

label: Our Campaigns candidate ID
missing: Nothing captured. The rendered text is about 1,000 chars of random characters and the screenshot is a blank white page, which looks like anti-bot obfuscation or a failed render rather than a real page.
label_issues: status 'wrong_page' / 'never mentions the entity' is misleading. The page is not another record but unreadable junk, so blocked / challenge_suspected (or load_failed) fits better. It should not suggest that the Wikidata id is wrong.
notable: Cannot verify whether candidate 96417 is Twain from this crawl.

label: Archive Site Trinity College Cambridge ID
missing: Nothing substantial. The AtoM page has only the authorized name, pseudonym, dates, one family relationship (Cyril Clemens) and three 'Subject of' archival descriptions, and all are captured. An 'Export EAC' link exists on the page and could have given structured EAC-CPF, but it is not captured.
label_issues: None. Page text only is defensible, but note that AtoM offers EAC-CPF export, so structured data is in fact obtainable.
notable: Cyril Clemens is labelled 'cousin' by the site; he was a distant relative at most.

description '"Twain, Mark" published on  by Oxford University Press.' (boilerplate og:description with a blank date)
image 'https://www.oxfordmusiconline.com/grovemusic/cover/default' (default cover, chrome)
record_modified '2013-11-26' (print publication date, not modification)
missing: The meta description gives birth place 'Florida, MO' and death place 'Redding, CT' with full dates, but these are not split into birth_place, death_place, birth_date or death_date elements.

Grove Music Online is available by subscription') and only the heading, byline, DOI and dates are visible. status should be login_wall_suspected, or the atlas should say that only the heading is visible.
notable: Paywalled article; only metadata and the meta-description abstract are reachable.

label: Diamond Catalog ID for persons and organisations
wrong_values: description 'Person' (og:description record type, not a description)
missing: The page shows the full record but the profile has only 5 OpenGraph values. Missing from the page: gender 'Male'; exact life dates '30 November 1835 — 21 April 1910'; place of birth 'Florida, Missouri'; place of death 'Redding, Connecticut'; nationality 'United States of America'; profession 'Romancier, journaliste et humoriste'; language English; the Arabic authorized form 'توين، مارك، 1835‒1910'; the variant 'Clemens, Samuel Langhorne, 1835‒1910'; cross-links ISNI/VIAF/FRBNF/ARK BNF/IdRef/WKD/LC/Wikipedia; and counts of Publication 14 / Production 12 / Collaborator 11. No page-text pass appears to have run (page_text_values 0).

label: Union Catalog of Armenian Libraries authority ID

notable: Two of the three Wikidata values (28678, 29148) redirect to the Koha 404 page. They are dead or deleted authority ids and should probably be removed from Wikidata.

name_preferred 'Bibliografii dějin Českých zemí' (site title)

description values '1835', '1910', '1835 1910', '1835-1910' (raw MARC subfield fragments, not descriptions)

It should be 'ad-hoc JSON/XML' (or library format), with access JS-rendered/XHR rather than plain HTTP. The 10 see_also nav URLs and the 30 fragmentary 'description' values inflate the value count (84) and distort the uniqueness share.
notable: Wikidata holds two UUIDs: a84f8e03... is the main Twain record and 21588604... is the pseudonym record 'Conte, Louis de'. Both are his.

label: Portal da Literatura ID
missing: Only the truncated og:description was captured and no page-text pass ran (page_text_values 0). The page shows: the full biography with marriage to Olívia Langdon in 1870, residence in Hartford, roles as orador/humorista/impressor/condutor de barcos, death year 1910, and named works (As Aventuras de Huckleberry Finn, As Aventuras de Tom Sawyer, Um Yankee na Corte do Rei Artur, As Cartas da Terra); a 'Livros escritos por Mark Twain' list of 8 Portuguese editions with years (e.g. 'As Bênçãos da Civilização' 2019, 'O Solilóquio do Rei Leopoldo' 2018, 'Um Candidato Idóneo' 1879); and the life span '1835 - 1910'.
label_issues: status 'login_wall_suspected' / resolved=false are wrong. The login form is a sidebar and the author page is fully visible, so status should be ok and resolved true.
notable: The site lists 'Rikki-Tikki-Tavi' (2016) among 'Livros escritos por Mark Twain'. That is Kipling's story, so it is a site error.

label: RILM ID
